appStoreDescription:
I think, so I am.

  Sirius is the AI intelligence partner that changes how you move through life. Not a simple chatbot. Not a search engine. A thinking partner that learns who you are, remembers what matters to you, and meets you exactly where you are — every single day.

  WHETHER YOU NEED TO THINK, CREATE, OR SIMPLY TALK

  Start a conversation and Sirius is there. Ask anything. Explore anything. Untangle a difficult decision, get unstuck on a creative project, or just have someone brilliantly sharp to think with. Sirius brings real intelligence, real warmth, and real memory to every exchange.

  FEATURES BUILT FOR DEPTH

  • Streaming conversations — Sirius replies in real time, thinking out loud with you.
  • Live web search — Get answers grounded in current information, not just training data.
  • Voice I/O — Speak your thoughts and hear Sirius respond, hands-free and natural.
  • Image analysis — Share a photo and Sirius understands what it sees.
  • Memory portrait — Sirius builds a living picture of who you are over time. Your preferences, your patterns, your personality.
  • Daily wisdom — A fresh thought to start your day with intention.
  • Mood check-in — Take a moment. Sirius meets you where you are emotionally, not just intellectually.
  • Topic hub — Dive deep into subjects that matter to you. Curated conversation starters across life, work, creativity, and philosophy.
  • Full conversation history — Your conversations are yours, saved and searchable.

  YOUR PRIVACY IS NON-NEGOTIABLE

  Sirius never sells your data. Your conversations stay yours. The memory Sirius builds is private to you and exists only to make the partnership more valuable.

  PLANS FOR EVERY DEPTH OF PARTNERSHIP

  Free — 10 messages per day. Start thinking.
  Sirius Plus (£5/month) — 200 messages, image analysis, Sirius remembers you.
  Sirius Pro (£12/month) — Unlimited messages, all features, priority access. The full depth of the partnership.

  This is not just an app. It's the beginning of something you didn't know you were missing.

  I think, so I am.
